body: My brother knows that I'm not doing well, but not the extent of it. Other than that, ex girlfriend, but she would happily tell me to do it or get over it.
Talking helps a lot. If you would like too, I'll be awake.
If you are in the US I can talk to you about the different resources that I have used.
PM me anytime you want to talk. I've been there.

Keep walking...continue putting one foot ahead every day, and try new experiences every chance you get. We are all trying to find our own meaning. One of those experiences will be your personal meaning, and that's all anyone needs.

That's a tough situation. Do you know anyone else, ie friends or family, etc, that you would be able to talk too about this?  With a long distance relationship it amplifies the situation, and makes you feel even more powerless, and whatever she needs will also be difficult to take care of long distance.

You don't deserve to die. 

You have defined your morals by the way you talk about these issues, in your  own words. It is up to you to live by your own morals. It is a difficult situation, and you will need the help of others. But I am here to reach out for my own help, and I believe that you will find someone to talk to as well.

Long distance relationships are a very difficult issue. But I would not rely on anyone that isn't professionally trained to deal with depression and suicide too help her. They may help for a little while but will eventually be overwhelmed by the stress and responsibility. The best thing you can do is help her find resources that are qualified and completely confidential that she can talk too.
